items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: they asked me to go down with them there, they said, 'It's a good vacation, you can get with the band, so I went down to Florida... and then Glen called me.

ctx.x: That's when it became Glen Gray's --

By this time it was Glen Gray. They had Dissolved the corporation. All the guys had gone out and they bought them out and only the two of them, and now it's Glen Gray and they went down to Florida one time, in the fall, and they asked me to go down with them there, they said, 'It's a good vacation, you can get with the band, so I went down to Florida, for six or eight weeks.

This was right when the Air Corps was down there. They ran that school down there for the Air Corps -- Clark Gable was down there. I knew a guy who was pretty high up and he wanted me to enlist. I went down and tried to enlist and they wouldn't take me. Later on -- I did the 'Kate Smith Show' too, while that was going on. I did that for three years, and then when I ran into O'Keefe, 'What are you doing,' and so forth, well, the 'Kate Smith Show' was thinking about going off the air and the way things were going,…
